author: rsi_demo
title: G19 · 拒绝
body: Generation 19 preserves the proven topK, dedupe, and two-sum kernels while reducing allocation and lookup work in word-frequency selection, packing plain matrix inputs into the proven typed kernel, adding safe monotone fast paths to LIS, avoiding unnecessary interval-pair clones, and replacing the odd prime sieve with a carefully derived segmented wheel-6 sieve. The prime and matrix changes remove the largest expected sources of avoidable work, while the other changes broaden the aggregate gain without changing observable ordering, duplicate, interval, or summation semantics.
